featured_reviews.name: Dheeraj Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Personal experience with jewellery scheme and making charges

Review:

Hemson has been our preferred jewellery store for over 15 years, which is why I am sharing this experience for general awareness.

We purchased a gold chain (as they didn't allow us to purchase a coin) weighing 9.33 grams under a savings scheme where monthly deposits are made for 12 months and a benefit for the 13th month is added by the jeweller, after which jewellery can be selected. During the course of the scheme, when we explored the option of pausing, we were initially informed that this was not permitted. Subsequently, we were advised to visit either on 31st December 2025 or after 4th January 2026.

When the purchase was completed, 25% making charges were applied on a relatively simple chain. To better understand this, I checked with a few other reputed jewellery brands, who indicated that such charges are generally lower for similar designs. Based on those discussions, the charges here appeared to be on the higher side.

This experience was unexpected, particularly given our long association as repeat customers. Informal discussions with acquaintances also suggested that making charges at this store may be comparatively higher.

Based on our personal experience, we have decided to pause future purchases from Hemson. I would recommend that prospective buyers clarify making charges, scheme terms, and conditions in detail before proceeding.

For those seeking greater pricing transparency, exploring well-known, publicly listed jewellery brands may be worth considering. Our friends and family have also been informed of our experience.

Rating:  1/5 — Very Disappointing Experience
Dissatisfied Experience: AVOID AT ALL COSTS
​I am writing this to warn every potential customer in Mulund: before stepping  into Swarnaprabha Jewellers.According to me  This shop is running a systematic tactic involving under-purity gold, predatory sales tactics, and unethical payment demands.
​1. The "100% Payment" Trap & Poor Craftsmanship
I paid a 60% advance, but when the jewelry was finally shown to me after 20 days, it was full of mistakes and not at all what I ordered. Instead of fixing their errors, the owner demanded the remaining 40% payment immediately before any corrections were made. When I refused to pay for a defective product, the owner turned rude, blaming me for "pending payments" while his own craftsmen took months to do simple fixes. He literally told me to "close the deal and take it as it is." No professional jeweler asks for full payment before the customer is satisfied with the design.
​2. Purity Concerns (The 916/22k )
I purchased jewelry sold and hallmarked as 22k (916). However, my independent touch report proved it was only 20k to 21k. When confronted, the salesman, Devendra, had the audacity to suggest I "melt the gold" so he could buy it back. Why would any customer pay making charges for new jewelry just to be told to melt it? It is a complete joke and a total loss for the buyer.
​3. Predatory Salesman (Devendra)
Devendra is extremely greedy for profits and treats customers like beggars once the money is paid. He constantly pushes "melting advice" while buying old gold to provide less value. He is only interested in playing with you out of your old gold assets.
​4. Quality & Pricing Red Flags
​Overcharging: Their rates are ₹5,000–₹6,000 higher than the entire Mulund market. They charge for 997 purity but provide 90-solder gold in return.
​Fragile Jewelry: The new jewelry I purchased breaks repeatedly. The quality is pathetic.
​Fear of Law: Once they realized that they are caught in  their purity concern, they suddenly started bargaining on making charges because they are terrified of legal action
​5. Rude Management
The owner is incredibly rude and has zero business sense. He is entirely dependent on his staff, who are openly  confusing customers. He refuses to take responsibility for incorrect designs and claims "correction costs are too high" to avoid fixing his own mistakes.
​This shop is a den of in lack of transparency.Purity test result i received was different from what was claimed. Save your hard-earned money and go to an honest, reputed jeweler. customer_updates.text:
I am Tanishq customer from more than 10 years. But now a days I am preferring some other brands. Not because makings are high or designs are not good. But due to other factors overall rate of product is increased .
Don't know why, gold rate is much higher in Tanishq than rates in other brands. For e.g 22 carat gold rate on 14th Aug'21 was Rs. 4617 in Tanishq but on same date 22 carat  gold rate was Rs. 4400 in Malabar which is few steps ahead of Tanishq. Also while exchange for pure gold 24 carat they deduct 3% from actual amount. But this is not deducted from any other brands and should not be deducted.
